confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living sources (Expatistan, Numbeo via Expatica, a Boston drinks guide) and menu snapshots, with dates ranging from 2017 to 2026. Beer and coffee are the most consistent across sources; wine and cocktails are wide ranges. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings, and July is peak season. The FX observation is the only RBA-sourced figure I could locate, and it is dated 2026-03-20, so it is not the latest available on the generation date (2026-11-19). I could not confirm a newer RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors are based on Boston-specific aggregated price sources. Accommodation anchors are model estimates for Boston in high season.
